import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/liuxuedeng/Django-Agent')
evidence = root / 'docs/refactor-evidence'
manifest = evidence / '20261012-read-auth-freeze.json'
expected = {
    'packages/core/src/storage/database.ts': 'e75072880cd514401fd5f7c5646b0742f959135cd4b712dfdb299541963c3a21',
    'packages/core/src/storage/row-codec.ts': 'ccad9bea6a5e0dfdacc9bbd8db835e8fef9dc4326d6697767b57456f51873da7',
    'packages/core/src/storage/read-database.ts': '80b7b8234b72ea40e15c319fb7766c91a70093a9187b775b2b3e05804a0565fe',
    'packages/core/src/auth/index.ts': '0ee2ffcc8f09d7e45d1c598e2f03f292bc57fdc0376077ee54eba8d88a47326b',
    'packages/core/src/auth/reader.ts': 'd4a8fecceddf13e1e1e9955096ea8449f615f96ce9e3eeea29e8478d716dd992',
}
owned = [*expected, 'packages/core/test/read-database.test.ts',
         'packages/core/test/auth-reader.test.ts',
         'packages/core/test/auth-discard-issue.test.ts',
         'docs/desktop-refactor/READ-DATABASE-AUTH-IMPLEMENTATION.md']
design = 'docs/desktop-refactor/CORE-READ-WORKER-DESIGN.md'

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

for name, value in expected.items():
    assert sha(root / name) == value, name
assert sha(root / design) == 'a5a4c0c99ad94d5b27af9dfe9033c5a910a0a670735b6e66a6b5400df5927e15'
diff_checks = []
for name in owned:
    command = ['git', 'diff', '--no-index', '--check', '/dev/null', name]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode in (0, 1) and not result.stdout and not result.stderr, (name, result)
    diff_checks.append({'path': name, 'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'no_whitespace_diagnostics': True})
tracked_diff = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', '--', *owned], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert tracked_diff.returncode == 0 and not tracked_diff.stdout and not tracked_diff.stderr

prefixes = [
    '20261012-read-auth-red', '20261012-read-auth-first-green',
    '20261012-auth-discard-red', '20261012-read-auth-guard-green',
    '20261012-auth-discard-generation-red', '20261012-read-auth-discard-green',
    '20261012-read-auth-related', '20261012-read-auth-typecheck',
    '20261012-read-auth-final-green',
]
commands = []
for prefix in prefixes:
    meta_path, log_path = evidence / (prefix + '.json'), evidence / (prefix + '.tap')
    command = json.loads(meta_path.read_text())
    log = log_path.read_text()
    command.update({'metadata_path': str(meta_path.relative_to(root)), 'metadata_sha256': sha(meta_path),
                    'log_path': str(log_path.relative_to(root)), 'log_sha256': sha(log_path)})
    for key in ('tests', 'pass', 'fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped'):
        value = re.search(r'^# ' + key + r' (\d+)$', log, re.MULTILINE)
        if value:
            command[key] = int(value.group(1))
    if prefix.endswith('typecheck'):
        diagnostics = re.findall(r'^(src/[^\n]+): error TS\d+: [^\n]+', log, re.MULTILINE)
        assert len(diagnostics) == 7
        assert all(path.startswith('src/runtime/owner-') for path in diagnostics)
        command.update({'passing': False, 'diagnostic_count': 7, 'diagnostic_locations': diagnostics,
                        'scope': 'root-owned runtime protocol integration in progress; no storage/auth/knowledge diagnostic'})
    commands.append(command)

script_paths = [Path('/tmp/marlin-read-auth-command.py'), Path('/tmp/marlin-extract-auth-reader.py'), Path(__file__)]
scripts = [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(path), 'source': path.read_text()} for path in script_paths]
fixture_patterns = ['marlin-read-database 中文 *', 'marlin-read-missing 中文 *',
                    'marlin-auth-reader 中文 *', 'marlin-discard-issue 中文 *']
remaining = [str(path) for pattern in fixture_patterns for path in Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).glob(pattern)]
assert not remaining, remaining

# Create the target before checking its document link.
manifest.write_text('{}\n')
document = root / owned[-1]
links = []
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', document.read_text()):
    if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
        continue
    path = (document.parent / target.split('#', 1)[0]).resolve()
    assert path.is_file(), str(path)
    links.append({'target': target, 'resolved': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'exists': True})
node = subprocess.run(['node', '--version'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
dependencies = {}
for package in ('better-sqlite3', 'tsx', 'typescript'):
    package_path = root / 'packages/core/node_modules' / package / 'package.json'
    dependencies[package] = json.loads(package_path.read_text())['version']

record = {
    'created_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Stage 2 shared read-only storage/authentication extraction and trusted owner discardIssue only',
    'source_freeze': [{'path': name, 'sha256': sha(root / name)} for name in owned],
    'approved_design': {'path': design, 'sha256': sha(root / design)},
    'commands': commands,
    'runtime': {'node': node, 'installed_dependencies': dependencies},
    'verification_summary': {'final_regression_tests': {'pass': 17, 'fail': 0},
                             'existing_related_tests': {'pass': 36, 'fail': 0},
                             'typecheck': 'exit 2; 7 root-owned transitional runtime errors, not passing',
                             'build': 'not run; root owns unified build', 'full_suite': 'not run'},
    'red_semantics': {'initial_red': '12 genuine contract failures against explicit incomplete implementations; no missing import used as RED',
                      'discard_red': '3 failures against explicitly incomplete trusted cleanup',
                      'generation_red': '1 actual failure: old issued generation incorrectly revoked later refresh generation in the same device family',
                      'fixture_mistake': 'First green follow-up corrupt JSON insertion hit legitimate owner CHECK constraint; repaired isolated fixture, not product RED',
                      'prepare_failure': 'query_only assignment acted during native prepare before late readonly rejection; fixed by pre-prepare guard',
                      'wal_assertion': 'Strict native guard kept; read journal mode through equivalent readonly pragma table query'},
    'checks': {'tracked_diff_check_exit': tracked_diff.returncode, 'all_owned_file_whitespace_checks': diff_checks,
               'local_document_links': links, 'temporary_fixture_patterns': fixture_patterns, 'remaining_fixtures': remaining},
    'limits': ['No live database/GUI/Windows/package access', 'No external vendor/live configured model request; existing channel tests use loopback HTTP fixtures',
               'No Query Worker runtime routing, epoch integration or performance acceptance claim',
               'No dependency/lockfile change or commit; root-owned integration/typecheck/build remain pending'],
    'temporary_scripts': scripts,
}
for path in script_paths:
    path.unlink()
for script in scripts:
    script['removed'] = not Path(script['path']).exists()
assert all(script['removed'] for script in scripts)
manifest.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'manifest': str(manifest.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': sha(manifest),
                  'owned_files': len(owned), 'commands': len(commands), 'scripts_removed': len(scripts),
                  'links_checked': len(links)}, ensure_ascii=False))
